title: UninstallApplied
description:
The applied `uninstall` — what was removed. On a teardown that FAILED partway this is the
receipt of the work that actually landed, spelled exactly as the success receipt spells it.
**INFERRED** (additive-only).

binary_path.description: The running binary's own path — left in place; the human removes it with their installer.

builtin_dirs.description: The built-in `topos` skill's placed copies that were removed (topos-authored artifacts).

hook.description:
The ACTIVE harness's trigger scrub report (surfaced honestly — `Inactive` when nothing was
armed). Absent on a teardown that failed before the scrubs ran: the trigger is still armed,
and a report saying otherwise would be the falsehood this field exists to prevent.

mcp_drifted.description: The MCP config files whose hand-edited topos entries were LEFT in place.

mcp_files.description: The MCP config files topos-placed server entries were removed from.

project_hooks.description:
The scrub of the hooks the checkout the command ran in held (`project_hook_files` on the
describe): one row per file that held a topos entry, removed or (disclosed) not. Empty
outside a project, and when no project hook was topos's. **Additive.**

sidecar_removed.description:
Whether the `~/.topos/` sidecar tree was deleted (false = there was nothing to delete, or
the teardown never got that far).

triggers.description:
The breadth scrub's outcomes — other agents whose trigger the sweep removed (or could not,
disclosed); clean no-ops stay off the receipt.

CurrencyKind.description:
What fires the update check for a harness — drives HONEST receipt copy ("current by next session",
"within about a minute", …). `ExplicitPullOnly` is the honest-degrade floor.

oneOf.description:
A session-boundary hook runs the sweep (Claude Code's SessionStart; Hermes's
`on_session_start`/`on_session_reset`) — updates are current when a session begins.

A harness-scheduled recurring job runs the sweep (OpenClaw's silent cron) — updates land
within the cadence while the harness's scheduler is running.
No automatic trigger is provably live — updates land on an explicit `topos update`.

TriggerReport.description:
The result of (un)installing ONE agent's auto-update trigger — what was touched + the marker, so
re-install is idempotent (the marker is a managed sentinel block in the config edit, NEVER in skill
bytes). The one shape every trigger reports in, whichever machinery served it.

currency_kind.description: Only an `active` state carries a live kind; every other state advertises the explicit-pull floor.

marker_id.description: `topos` + agent slug + schema version + command identity.

note.description: The consent step still owed, or the evidence-level caveat — `None` when nothing needs saying.

touched_path.description: The config file edited (never a skill dir).

oneOf.description: An equivalent command exists without our marker — adopt-or-leave, never blind-append.
